statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-44903 (GHSA-fw8g-cg8f-9j28) is a stored XSS in the Prometheus server's legacy web UI heatmap, which is only rendered when the prometheus binary is launched with --enable-feature=old-ui. Loki 3.7.x imports github.com/prometheus/prometheus/web/api/v1 only for the PrometheusVersion struct (version reporting in pkg/loki/version_handler.go, pkg/util/build/build.go, pkg/analytics/*); the legacy web UI templates and heatmap render path are not imported or compiled into the Loki binary. Loki 3.7 cannot take the v0.311.3 bump that would patch this CVE because v0.311.3 removes the named type discovery.SDMetrics that pkg/ruler/base/notifier.go references.

CVE-2026-44903 (GHSA-fw8g-cg8f-9j28) is a stored XSS in the Prometheus server's legacy web UI heatmap, which is only rendered when the prometheus binary is launched with --enable-feature=old-ui. Loki 3.7.x imports github.com/prometheus/prometheus/web/api/v1 only for the PrometheusVersion struct (version reporting in pkg/loki/version_handler.go, pkg/util/build/build.go, pkg/analytics/*); the legacy web UI templates and heatmap render path are not imported or compiled into the Loki binary. Loki 3.7 cannot take the v0.311.3 bump that would patch this CVE because v0.311.3 removes the named type discovery.SDMetrics that pkg/ruler/base/notifier.go references.

CVE-2026-42154 affects the Prometheus server's remote-read HTTP handler (/api/v1/read), which uses a snappy decoder that does not validate declared payload length before allocating memory. Loki 3.7.x uses github.com/prometheus/prometheus/storage/remote only on the client side (pkg/ruler/storage/instance/instance.go calls remote.NewStorage for the ruler WAL) and never instantiates remote.NewReadHandler or routes /api/v1/read in its HTTP server, so the vulnerable handler is not reachable in the Loki binary. Loki 3.7 cannot take the v0.311.3 bump that would patch this CVE because v0.311.3 removes the named type discovery.SDMetrics that pkg/ruler/base/notifier.go references.

CVE-2026-42151 affects the Prometheus server's /api/v1/status/config endpoint failing to redact the Azure AD remote-write OAuth client_secret field. Loki 3.7.x vendors github.com/prometheus/prometheus/storage/remote/azuread transitively via config and storage/remote/client, but does not expose /api/v1/status/config or any equivalent endpoint that serializes its remote-write configuration back over HTTP, so the vulnerable config-display path is unreachable in the Loki binary. Loki 3.7 cannot take the v0.311.3 bump that would patch this CVE in Prometheus because v0.311.3 removes the named type discovery.SDMetrics that pkg/ruler/base/notifier.go references.

CVE-2026-44903 affects the Prometheus server legacy web UI heatmap rendering path. Netdata vendors github.com/prometheus/prometheus as a Go library for collectors and does not run the Prometheus server or expose the legacy Prometheus web UI, so the vulnerable rendering path is not present in the executable surface. The fixed version v0.311.3 is incompatible with Netdata v2.10.3.

Tempo builds with Prometheus packages for metrics and querying but does not run the Prometheus server or expose its web UI templates. The vulnerable rendering paths in prometheus/web are not part of Tempo's execution surface. The fixed version v0.311.3 is incompatible with Tempo v2.10.5.

CVE-2026-44903 is a cross-site scripting issue in Prometheus's web UI, same vulnerability class as GHSA-fw8g-cg8f-9j28 and the same fixed version (0.311.3). Istioctl uses Prometheus libraries as a client for metrics collection but does not register Prometheus's web/ui templates or call prometheus/web.New, so the vulnerable rendering paths are not reachable. The fixed version v0.311.3 is incompatible with Istio 1.28 and 1.29 (imports github.com/prometheus/prometheus/tsdb/errors which was removed in v0.311.3).

CVE-2026-44903 is classified by Scout as Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation (cross-site scripting) in Prometheus's web UI, same vulnerability class as GHSA-fw8g-cg8f-9j28 and the same fixed version (0.311.3). Pyroscope ships its own React-based UI under / and /explore and does not register Prometheus's web/ui templates or call prometheus/web.New, so the vulnerable rendering paths are not reachable. No public NVD or GHSA advisory is available at the time of writing; Prometheus 3.11.3 release notes only list CVE-2026-42151, CVE-2026-42154, and GHSA-fw8g-cg8f-9j28. If a published advisory later reveals a non-web-UI code path, this statement will need to be replaced.

GHSA-fw8g-cg8f-9j28 is a cross-site scripting issue in Prometheus's web UI templates (/graph, /alerts, /rules). Pyroscope ships its own React-based UI under / and /explore and does not register Prometheus's web/ui templates or call prometheus/web.New, so the vulnerable rendering paths are not reachable. Note: pyroscope's source imports prometheus/web/api/v1 in pkg/usagestats and pkg/util/build for type-only access to the PrometheusVersion struct, which puts the package in the SBOM without instantiating any handlers. Same upstream fix line as CVE-2026-42151 / CVE-2026-42154; bump infeasible for 1.15-1.20.

CVE-2026-42154 is a snappy decompression DoS reachable through Prometheus's remote_read server handler (/api/v1/read). Pyroscope imports storage/remote only as a remote-write client (remote.NewWriteClient in pkg/metrics/exporter.go); the vulnerable remote.NewReadHandler is never constructed and no /api/v1/read route is registered. The fixed version v0.311.3 is incompatible with pyroscope 1.15-1.20's code (parser.ParseMetricSelector API removed); the bump only lands cleanly on pyroscope 1.21+, which is tracked separately.

CVE-2026-42151 exposes the Azure-AD remote-write client_secret via Prometheus's /-/config admin endpoint. Pyroscope does not run a Prometheus server: pkg/api/api.go registers only pyroscope's own routes (/ingest, /pyroscope/*, /api/v1/status/* via pyroscope's statusv1 proto service, etc.) and never instantiates prometheus/web.Handler, so /-/config is not routed. The fixed version v0.311.3 is incompatible with pyroscope 1.15-1.20's code (parser.ParseMetricSelector API removed); the bump only lands cleanly on pyroscope 1.21+, which is tracked separately.

Metrics-server is not a Prometheus server process and does not expose the Prometheus remote-read endpoint, so the vulnerable handler is not in the executable request path for this image.

CVE-2026-42151 concerns Azure AD remote-write OAuth credentials being exposed via the Prometheus server's /-/config HTTP API. DHI metrics-server builds a standalone controller binary; it does not run the Prometheus TSDB server or serve Prometheus operational endpoints, so that configuration surface is never reachable in this image.
This advisory is a stored XSS class issue in the Prometheus interactive web UI assets under web/ui. The adapter container does not ship or execute the Prometheus web UI or its frontend bundles.

CVE-2026-42154 affects unauthenticated requests to the Prometheus remote-read HTTP endpoint (/api/v1/read) on a running Prometheus server. This image does not run the Prometheus server or expose that API surface; github.com/prometheus/prometheus is linked only as a Go dependency for metrics-related libraries used by the adapter.

CVE-2026-42151 affects the Prometheus HTTP configuration endpoint (/-/config) when Azure AD remote-write OAuth is configured, exposing client_secret because the field was not modeled as a Secret type. The keda-metrics-apiserver image ships only the metrics adapter binary built from cmd/adapter; it does not run the Prometheus server or expose /-/config or remote-write storage endpoints.

Companion advisory for CVE-2026-42151 on the Prometheus module vendored via Grafana Loki. Promtail retains Loki's upstream prometheus pin because v0.311.3 breaks the module graph; promtail does not execute the affected Prometheus server XSS surface.

Promtail is built from Grafana Loki and retains Loki's upstream prometheus module pin. Adopting prometheus v0.311.3 breaks the Loki module graph (removed/moved packages). The promtail binary uses a limited client-side subset of Prometheus libraries; the server-side code paths associated with this CVE are not exercised in this image.

Loki Canary 2.9.x and 3.6.x cannot safely take github.com/prometheus/prometheus@v0.311.3 yet. Waiting for an upstream/source-compatible fix or backport path before bumping these tracks.

CVE-2026-40179 is a stored XSS vulnerability in the Prometheus web UI, specifically in web/ui/mantine-ui/src/pages/query/uPlotChartHelpers.ts, web/ui/react-app/src/pages/graph/GraphHelpers.ts, web/ui/react-app/src/pages/graph/MetricsExplorer.tsx, and web/ui/react-app/src/vendor/flot/jquery.flot.heatmap.js. Telegraf vendors github.com/prometheus/prometheus only as a Go library for metric parsing (prompb, promql, model packages) and does not ship the Prometheus binary, web UI handlers, or any of the affected frontend assets, so the vulnerable code is not present in this image.
